verdict.rationale: The evidence shows customizable virtual cards, generic transaction rules that auto-decline authorizations, and relayed authorisation for real-time approve/decline decisions. None of it documents single-use cards, merchant-locking, or exact-amount caps. Generic rules and a developer-built authorization webhook are building blocks or adjacent controls, not the documented capability this story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue single-use and tightly scoped cards — one purchase, one merchant, an exact amount — so a leaked number is worthless the moment it's used
